test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A solid sphere is perfectly placed inside a cube so that it touches all six internal faces. What percentage of the cube's total volume is not occupied by the sphere?
solution:
**Given:**

A solid sphere is perfectly fitted inside a cube

Sphere touches all 6 faces of cube

**Formula used:**

Volume of cube = a³

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × r³

Percentage not occupied = [(Volume of cube − Volume of sphere) / Volume of cube] × 100

**Calculation:**

Since sphere touches all faces

⇒ Side of cube a = Diameter of sphere = 2r

Volume of cube

⇒ (2r)³ = 8r³

Volume of sphere

⇒ 4/3 × π × r³

Unoccupied volume

⇒ 8r³ − (4/3)πr³

Fraction unoccupied

⇒ [8 − (4/3)π] / 8

⇒ 1 − (π / 6)

Percentage not occupied

⇒ [1 − (π / 6)] × 100

⇒ [(6 − π)/6] × 100

Using π = 22/7

⇒ (6 − 22/7) / 6 × 100

⇒ (20/7) / 6 × 100

⇒ (20 / 42) × 100

⇒ 47.6%

**∴ About 47.6% of the cube’s volume is not occupied by the sphere.**
